description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's last ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.
